The '''Chiss Defense Fleet''' was one of the internal defense [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]]<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy's]] [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Expansionary Defense Fleet]], that along with the Household and Colonial [[Phalanx (Chiss)|Phalanxes]],<ref name="TEA" /> was charged with repelling aggressive incursions and considering long-term strategic concerns.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==History==
{{Quote|We have a significant number of stars and star systems, yes. But the Nine Families have long discouraged our people from probing or prying into the territories of others. Certainly the Defense Fleet and all official personnel are required to stay within our own borders.|[[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]]|<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />}}
At some point by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Vong Date">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], establishes that the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] have already [[Battle between the Chiss and Yuuzhan Vong|fought]] the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the events of the novel take place.</ref> a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Ar'alani's force|force]] of the Defense Fleet [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] participated in the [[Battle between the Chiss and Yuuzhan Vong|battle]] against a small [[Yuuzhan Vong reconnaissance force|reconnaissance force]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet]], in which the Chiss were victorious.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

In case of an enemy invasion,<ref name="TEA" /> the Defense Fleet in earnest began to fortify a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] known as [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]] as an emergency refuge<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> in 27 BBY.<ref name="Outbound Flight Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> The Defense Fleet personnel built fortifications<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> known as the [[firepoint]]s and scattered [[Cruiser/Legends|war vessels]] throughout the cluster.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

==Personnel==
{{Quote|Senior officers of the Defense Fleet belong to no family. They're stripped of family name and privilege and made part of the Defense Hierarchy in order that they may serve all Chiss without deference or prejudice.''"<br />"''So military command is merit-based, and not something that comes from Family connections?''"<br />"''Exactly. Officers are taken into the Hierarchy once they've proven themselves, just as the Ruling Families themselves select merit adoptives.|Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo and Maris Ferasi|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
Both the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Expansionary Fleet]]<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> and the Defense Fleet wore specialized [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Defense Fleet uniform]]s. The black color of the uniform signified that the Defense Fleet recruited its members from all of the [[Chiss family/Legends|Chiss families]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> When a [[Chiss warrior/Legends|Chiss warrior]] was accepted into the Defense Fleet, they were made a [[Merit adoptive/Legends|merit adoptive]] of a Chiss family.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

[[Chiss officer/Legends|Chiss officers]] were required to prove themselves similar to how the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]] selected merit adoptives to be taken into the [[Defense Hierarchy]]. Upon promotion to a [[Senior officer/Legends|senior officer]] in the Defense Fleet, the officer was stripped of family name and privilege and made part of the Hierarchy in order that they may serve all Chiss without deference or prejudice. The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] incorrectly believed that the reason Admiral Ar'alani wore a white uniform was because she was connected to the Defense Fleet instead of the Expansionary Fleet.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==Equipment==
Unlike the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of the Expansionary Fleet which were equipped with more powerful [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]], the Defense Fleet vessels relied on a colony system's network of boosters and repeaters, and were equipped with lesser transmitters.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chiss Defense Fleet first appeared in the [[2004]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> The [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], also written by Zahn, established the Chiss Defense Fleet as a distinct organization.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

There is a discrepancy regarding the senior officers of the Chiss Defense Fleet. General Prard'ras'kleoni retains his family name in the ''Survivor's Quest'',<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> but the ''Outbound Flight'' establishes that senior officers of the Defense Fleet were stripped of their family names and were made part of the Defense Hierarchy.<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> This article assumes Prard'ras'kleoni hasn't proven himself, and thus wasn't made part of the Hierarchy, despite the fact that he's a senior officer in the Defense Fleet.
